notes.title: Big changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30197983/75d81ff8240e955d38a89222aef03ec3711ffadf.png[/img]

Head Goal has been updated!

You can enjoy new graphics. The game was translated into many languages. 

Get your friends and check the changes.

notes.title: New prices in the shop
notes.notes:
Since today all items are 3 times cheaper!

Check the shop now: https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/687850/browse/?filter=all

We hope you like the new prices.

notes.title: Shop Price Drop!
notes.notes:
Item shop prices are -65% for a limited time! Use this opportunity to buy your favorite items and support the developer. Thank you!

https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/687850/browse/?filter=all

notes.title: Shop should work now (it was not working properly)
notes.notes:
Looks like the shop was not working, due to the wrong configuration on my side. Now it should work. Everyone who would like to support me is invited to buy the items!

Thank you!

notes.title: Shirt Number and Avatars!
notes.notes:
Head Goal has been updated! Now we have an Item Shop with a lot of cool stuff for you!

You can get a Shirt Number and pick the value from 1 to 99. You can also set an Avatar to look cool.

I have also improved the network code a bit.

Check the new update now!

notes.title: Head Goal Community Tournament!
notes.notes:
Would like like to play in a Head Goal Tournament?

Go to this link and signup your team: https://steamcommunity.com/app/687850/discussions/0/3211505894147295332/

notes.title: Head Goal is now Free To Play!
notes.notes: Download the game and enjoy it. You will be amazed how fun the game is. Simple to play, hard to master. Remember to invite your friends.
